Immigrate to America

移民美国 · 264 词 · 3 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1Attracted by the boom in America, my nephew teamed up with a Korean to cross the Bering Strait in the far north and enter America illegally. To avoid punishment from customs officials, they hid in a small ferry called the North Pole Seagull, sitting back to back without sleeping, showering or shaving for three days. After landing, they barely had time to worry about their lost luggage. The hardship of this crossing was apparent.

2At first, he made a living by means of raising cattle and then was hired in the aircraft industry. He lived in a Catholic district. The district had taken in a small number of Pakistani immigrants. The majority of its residents came from Italy or Denmark and kept up their own customs and traditions. Different blocks were sharply divided along racial and ethnic lines. It was unfair and needed reforming. But with nowhere else to go, my nephew lived on and managed to make a life for himself.

3My nephew’s fortune came when he bravely helped a conductor brake a tram to stop it from coming off the rails. The man was later elected vice-chairman of the Socialist Party. It occurred to my nephew that he could take the opportunity to ask the man for help. Thankful for the help, the man described my nephew’s brave deed in the documents and helped him apply to the authorities for the right to live in America. The federal justice authorities approved his application, though many other applicants were turned down. Before long, he started his own bakery and lived a better life.

高考英语3500词 · 36中文译文

移民美国

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1美国的繁荣吸引了我的侄子。他和一名韩国人结伴，从遥远的北方越过白令海峡，非法进入美国。为了躲避海关处罚，两人藏在一艘名叫“北极海鸥号”的小渡船上，背靠背坐了三天，没睡觉、没洗澡，也没刮胡子。上岸后，他们甚至顾不上为丢了行李而难过。这趟渡海之旅有多艰难，可想而知。

2他起初靠养牛谋生，后来在航空制造业找到了工作。他住在一个以天主教徒为主的社区。社区接纳了一小部分巴基斯坦移民，大多数居民来自意大利和丹麦，各自保留着自己的习俗和文化。不同街区按族裔划分，界线很分明。这种做法不公平，需要改变。侄子没有别的地方可去，只好在那里继续生活，努力给自己安顿下来。

3侄子的运气终于来了。一次，他勇敢地帮一名乘务员给有轨电车刹车，防止车辆脱轨。后来，那个人当选为社会党副主席。侄子想到，可以趁这个机会请对方帮忙。对方心怀感激，把他的勇敢事迹写进了申请材料，帮他向主管部门申请在美国居住的权利。他的申请得到了联邦司法部门的批准，许多其他申请人却没能获准。不久，他开了自己的面包店，日子过得比以前好了。
